description: StandardCoin AS operates platform supply vessels (PSVs). The company was formerly known as Standard Supply AS and changed its name to StandardCoin AS in July 2025. The company was founded in 2022 and is based in Oslo, Norway. Standard Supply AS is a subsidiary of S.D. Standard ETC PLC.
